title: Session refresh races with sign-out
summary: A refresh that finishes after sign-out writes the new token back into the keychain.
explanation: TokenStore.refresh() awaits the network call and then saves the token. signOut() clears the keychain but does not cancel an in-flight refresh, so a late response restores the session.
severityRationale: Medium. Rare timing, but a signed-out user can be signed back in.

research.analysis: signOut() at TokenStore.swift:70 does not cancel refreshTask.

options.title: Cancel refreshTask in signOut()
options.description: Keep a handle and cancel it.
cons: Needs a session generation check too

options.title: Session generation counter (follow-up PR)
options.description: Stamp each refresh with a session generation and drop stale results.

triage.complexityReason: Touches every token writer, about 9 files across Auth and Networking.
triage.confidenceReason: Generation counter is the known pattern for late writes.

decision.instruction: Out of scope for a retry fix; do it in its own PR after #42 lands.
